A helper function which switches the applier to FOLLOW state if it has synchronized with its master.

detaileddescription.para: A no-op request does not affect any space, but it promotes vclock and is written to WAL.

briefdescription.para: Connect to a remote host and authenticate the client.
Execute and process JOIN request (bootstrap the instance).
Read one transaction from network using applier's input buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Transaction rows are placed onto fiber gc region. We could not use applier input buffer to store rows because rpos is adjusted as xrow is decoded and the corresponding network input space is reused for the next xrow.

briefdescription.para: Allocate a new synchro_entry to be passed to the journal engine in async write way.
Apply all rows in the rows queue as a single transaction.

detaileddescription.para: Return 0 for success or -1 in case of an error.

briefdescription.para: Notify the applier's write fiber that there are more ACKs to send to master.
Execute and process SUBSCRIBE request (follow updates from a master).
Start a client to a remote master using a background fiber.

detaileddescription.para: If recovery is finalized (i.e. r->writer != NULL) then the client connect to a master and follow remote updates using SUBSCRIBE command.
If recovery is not finalized (i.e. r->writer == NULL) then the client connects to a master, downloads and processes a checkpoint using JOIN command and then switches to 'follow' mode.
